description: This file sets up and runs an asynchronous pipeline for a conversational AI system using various services and components, including transport, speech-to-text, language model, text-to-speech, and turn analysis, with event handlers for client connection and disconnection.

classes.name: HeyGenTransport
classes.description: Transport class for HeyGen API handling client connection events and media streaming.

classes.name: Pipeline
classes.description: Represents the processing pipeline for the conversational system.

classes.name: PipelineTask
classes.description: Encapsulates a pipeline and its parameters for execution.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that sets up and runs the conversational pipeline.

methods.name: on_client_connected
methods.description: Event handler triggered when a client connects, initiates conversation.

methods.name: on_client_disconnected
methods.description: Event handler triggered when a client disconnects, cancels ongoing tasks.
